sheet.lyrics:
[Verse]
In all the noise and daily rush,
sometimes a person appears before your eyes,
who simply listens, who understands,
and with whom time passes so easily.
You meet me without masks or pretenses,
you simply let me be myself.
With you, there is nothing to prove, nothing to do,
here thoughts are simply allowed to rest.

[Pre-Chorus]
It's the small things that count and remain,
quietly writing the most beautiful stories.
You are a light in the everyday gray,
giving me calm and deep trust.

[Chorus]
Thank you, Ilde, for your open heart,
for every kind word that brightens the days.
For your warmth that brings comfort,
and the gentle way your spirit guides things.
Your trust is the greatest gift of all –
I thank you for this friendship,
it means the world to me.

[Verse]
You share your dreams, your worries, your laughter,
the big emotions, the quiet things.
Your openness is like an open door,
something that only happens once in a lifetime.
When the world seems too loud or difficult,
it is your voice that reconciles and unites again.
A good conversation, an honest piece of advice,
nothing more is needed along this path.

[Pre-Chorus]
It's the quiet notes that endure and remain,
showing what matters most without grand gestures.
Sometimes just a single sentence is enough,
and everything falls back into place.

[Chorus]
Thank you, Ilde, for your open heart,
for every kind word that brightens the days.
For your warmth that brings comfort,
and the gentle way your spirit guides things.
Your trust is the greatest gift of all –
I thank you for this friendship,
it means the world to me.

[Bridge]
No obligations, no heavy weight,
just clear understanding and mutual light.
A friend like you is a rare treasure,
in the book of my life you hold a permanent place.
Simply thank you for everything you give and who you are.

[Chorus]
Thank you, Ilde, for your open heart,
for every kind word that brightens the days.
For your warmth that brings comfort,
and the gentle way your spirit guides things.
Your trust is the greatest gift of all –
I thank you for this friendship,
it means the world to me.

[Outro]
Without any frills, simple and true:
Thank you, Ilde.
I am glad that you exist.

sheet.title: In Harmony
sheet.lyrics:
[Verse]
You text me a message:
"I'm still farting, it never ends."
Just had to let another one rip,
hope nothing solid comes with it.
I read it on my screen and immediately feel for you:
Oh God, you poor thing, what are you going through?

[Pre-Chorus]
No picture, no sound, just a sad smiley,
’cause you’re suffering so much from this yourself …

[Chorus]
Oh Ilde, dear friend, what plagues your tummy so much?
Why won’t it give you any peace?
It’s not easy at all when the body goes crazy,
and you just can’t get any rest.
Out of pure sympathy, I fart along with you,
so you don’t have to complain all alone.
Together we’ll blast the whole world with sound,
until your tummy feels better again!

[Verse]
I just ask normally: "How are you doing today?"
You answer promptly and in agony:
"The third one in a row, the window needs to open,
my stomach chose me today."
You send an annoyed emoji with it,
and probably sigh all alone in front of the screen.
It’s not funny at all, you’re suffering so much,
and I feel your pain right through the screen.

[Pre-Chorus]
You text: "It just doesn’t stop!"
and your strength is slowly running out …

[Chorus]
Oh Ilde, dear friend, what plagues your tummy so much?
Why won’t it give you any peace?
It’s not easy at all when the body goes crazy,
and you just can’t get any rest.
Out of pure sympathy, I fart along with you,
so you don’t have to complain all alone.
Together we’ll blast the whole world with sound,
until your tummy feels better again!

[Bridge]
Actually, this isn’t funny at all,
but let’s meet up and really get down to business.
We’ll start a massive fart concert,
and make the halls shake.
We’ll turn every trouble into a hit!

[Chorus]
Oh Ilde, dear friend, what plagues your tummy so much?
Why won’t it give you any peace?
It’s not easy at all when the body goes crazy,
and you just can’t get any rest.
Out of pure sympathy, I fart along with you,
so you don’t have to complain all alone.
Together we’ll blast the whole world with sound,
until your tummy feels better again!

[Outro]
I'll tune in already …
*Pfff.*
Now it's your turn.
Our concert begins.

sheet.lyrics:
[Intro]
Candles dimly glow, shadows on the wall
Codex wakes the spell, follows the call

[Verse]
Outside howls the wind, through the bitter cold
Inside embers wake, stories left untold
Pumpkins start to grin, in the silent gloom
Codex sits in peace, deep inside the room
Amber reflections, shining in her eyes
Magic awakens, ancient spirits rise

[Chorus]
She fills the dark night with wonder and light
Where shadows and spirits dance into the night
They sway and they tremble, lost in the haze
The chamber is bound to the rites of old days
The shadows awaken, the fire leaps high
And dark ancient magic takes to the sky

[Verse]
Deep inside her room, burns a quiet flame
An iron black cauldron, of secrets untold
Secret ingredients, bubble and steam
Whispering vapors, rise like a dream
She stirs every potion with masterful hand
And weaves for our circle an unbroken band

[Chorus]
She fills the dark night with wonder and light
Where shadows and spirits dance into the night
They sway and they tremble, lost in the haze
The chamber is bound to the rites of old days
The shadows awaken, the fire leaps high
And dark ancient magic takes to the sky

[Bridge]
Lantern House glows, with shadows in rings
We whisper of wonder and mystical things
Nobody knows what is born in the brew
Yet Codex will watch over all of our crew

[Outro]
Candles burn down, the cauldron grows cold
A chuckle resounds from the legends of old
All drift away as the phantoms take flight
Only Codex remains till the morning light

CodexMundi sits at the table and ignores the bread,
thin sausages bring her only sorrow and dread.
She doesn't want to see small bites upon her plate,
only the very biggest may pass through her gate.
Massive and heavy, that's how the world tastes best,
a giant caliber beats out all the rest.

[Chorus]
CodexMundi wants them extra thick and extra long,
only for thick sausages she stays forever strong!
Tight and fully packed, heavy in her hand,
the thickest sausage in all the land!
No room for tiny stuff, the portion is immense,
she loves the sausage only in gigantic dimensions!

[Verse]
She looks at the meat counter with an expert eye,
the best sausage is juicy, giant, and wide.
Anything too skinny, she sends right back at once,
only a true colossus gives her what she wants.
The skin almost bursting, lying on the grill so neat,
that is for CodexMundi the truly perfect treat.

[Chorus]
CodexMundi wants them extra thick and extra long,
only for thick sausages she stays forever strong!
Tight and fully packed, heavy in her hand,
the thickest sausage in all the land!

she loves the sausage only in gigantic dimensions!

The plate is empty, yet her gaze stays stubborn:

sheet.title: Bladder vs. Ban (2)
sheet.style: german indie-pop acoustic pop-rock, punchy acoustic guitar, driving drums, playful bassline, energetic slightly exasperated female vocal, witty playful humorous sarcastic 116 BPM
sheet.lyrics:
[Verse]
It’s almost 1 AM, the monitor glare is bright,
my brain screams "Sleep!", but my pride wants to fight.
Can't let him win with the trash in this chat,
I should have been in bed hours ago, that's that.
Enter user Pauluz, pushing every single line,
dropping NSFW stuff that violates design,
posting inappropriate junk through the night:
"Oh come on, who says this isn't alright?"

[Pre-Chorus]
The screen shows: "Pauluz is typing…" and won't go away,
while I delete filth and wait for the light of day.
And as if this nonsense wasn't enough to withstand,
my bladder is screaming like an out-of-control band.

[Chorus]
I need to pee so bad, but I can't walk away,
or this troll thinks he won and he's here to stay!
Two cups of herbal tea shouting: "Let us out!",
but I'm glued to my chair, fighting round after round!
Pings in my DMs, pressure hits the ceiling,
Discord admin life—what a terrible feeling!

[Verse]
Legs crossed tight, fingers sore on the keys,
mind completely fried, begging on its knees.
Pauluz shares garbage no one wants to behold,
acting offended when he's rightfully told.
I type: "Read Rule Three! Keep it clean and mature!",
he whines: "It's just art, you're a prude, that's for sure!"
Exhaustion whispers: "Just hit him with the ban!",
but my stupid ego thinks we can reason like a man.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now Pauluz drops an essay, twelve paragraphs long!
My pelvis starts singing a desperate song.
One more gross meme, one more nasty reply,
and I’m floating right off into the midnight sky!

[Chorus]
I need to pee so bad, but I can't walk away,
or this troll thinks he won and he's here to stay!
Two cups of herbal tea shouting: "Let us out!",
but I'm glued to my chair, fighting round after round!
Pings in my DMs, pressure hits the ceiling,
Discord admin life—what a terrible feeling!

[Bridge]
One single click between freedom and pain,
am I really sacrificing my kidneys in vain?
"Pauluz is typing…"
Wait, hold on a sec.
It's about to strike one!
Purge, mute, bye—I am completely done!

[Outro]
Click.
Timeout for Pauluz, twenty-four hours to weep.
Filth deleted, time to finally sleep!
Chair rolls back, I'm sprinting down the hall,
diving for the porcelain, answering the call!
Good night, server.
Offline.

sheet.title: Der Küchenuhr-Blues (2)
sheet.style: German indie-pop, acoustic pop-rock, punchy acoustic guitar, playful bass, energetic male vocals, witty sarcastic mood, 116 BPM
sheet.lyrics:
[Verse]
Der Wecker brüllt um sechs Uhr früh, erbarmungslos und laut,
ich blinzle durch die Schlitze, weil der Nebel mich verhaut.
Die Mikrowelle zeigt halb acht, der Herd sagt viertel vor,
die Armbanduhr tickt völlig stumm und singt im Geisterchor.
Ich stolpre in die Küche, trete barfuß auf ’nen Stein,
wie spät zur Hölle kann es denn im echten Leben sein?

[Pre-Chorus]
War es vorwärts? War es rückwärts?
Wird der Tag nun kurz gedreht?
Haben wir die Zeit gestohlen,
oder kommen wir zu spät?

[Chorus]
Oh, die Zeitumstellung schlägt wieder zu,
bringt meinen Biorhythmus völlig um die Ruh!
Gestern war es dunkel, heute ist es grau,
keiner weiß es sicher, nicht mal meine Frau.
Eine Stunde vor, eine Stunde zurück –
wer das hier erfunden hat, der hatte echt kein Glück!

[Verse]
Die Katze will ihr Futter, pünktlich wie ein Metronom,
sie starrt mich an wie Hannibal und fordert ihre Ration.
„Es ist erst vier!“, sag ich zu ihr, sie faucht nur ins Gesicht:
Ob Sommer- oder Winterzeit, das schert die Mieze nicht.
Im Auto stimmt die Anzeige seit ungefähr drei Jahren,
ich hab aus reinem Trotz beschlossen, einfach so zu fahren.

[Bridge]
Im Frühling stellt man Gartenmöbel vor die Tür ins Gras,
im Herbst räumt man sie wieder weg – na ja, wer glaubt denn das?
Ich steh im Regen mit dem Stuhl und frier mir alles ab,
während ich verzweifelt meine Zeitzone verknapp.
Gibt es denn im Parlament kein einziges Gehirn,
das diesen Quatsch beendet? Mir brummt schon die Stirn!

[Verse]
Der Chef ruft an und wettert wild: „Wo bleiben Sie denn bloß?!“
Ich sag: „Chef, mein Zeitempfinden ist grad völlig los!
Nach Brüsseler Tabelle bin ich eigentlich zu früh,
doch relativ gesehen fehlt mir jegliche Energie.“
Er legt stumm auf, ich leg mich hin, zieh mir die Decke vor,
und schlafe bis zum nächsten März – mit Kissen auf dem Ohr.

[Outro]
Tick-tack, tick-tack…
War das jetzt vor?
Oder zurück?
Egal.
Gute Nacht.
Oder… guten Morgen?

sheet.title: No Price Tag (2)
sheet.lyrics:
[Verse]
I reach out my hand, trying to lift up your weight
'Cause watching you struggle is a burden I hate.
I tell you: "Please take it, I expect nothing in return,"
Yet you stand frozen, with that same old concern.
You’re shaped by people who only give to take back,
And you instantly feel guilty, caught in the trap.
I have to talk for so long till you see my heart through,
'Cause you truly believe that it isn't meant for you.

[Pre-Chorus]
And while I keep fighting to make you trust,
You put up a wall out of guilt and dust.
A quiet numbness creeps into my chest:
Will my helping hand be the end of our friendship?

[Chorus]
I don’t want to break what we have with what I give,
I just want things to get better for you.
You know who I am—I can’t change my skin,
I built this friendship with no conditions locked in.
I’m working on seeing where your boundaries lie,
To grasp why you feel in my debt when I try.
Just tell me where I stand, don’t leave me alone with the fear:
That you’ll turn away, just because you felt uneasy here.

[Verse]
Every discussion feels like walking a thin line,
Like an abyss opens up behind every good sign.
I don't know what you think, don't know how you feel,
If you’re pulling away while your thoughts spin the wheel.
I mean it so honestly, no terms and no price,
Yet whether I suffocate you is what keeps me up at night.
We keep texting as usual, but the unease won't depart,
And the spiral of doubt starts running through my heart.

[Pre-Chorus]
And while I keep fighting to make you trust,
You put up a wall out of guilt and dust.
A quiet numbness creeps into my chest:
Will my helping hand be the end of our friendship?

[Chorus]
I don’t want to break what we have with what I give,
I just want things to get better for you.
You know who I am—I can’t change my skin,
I built this friendship with no conditions locked in.
I’m working on seeing where your boundaries lie,
To grasp why you feel in my debt when I try.
Just tell me where I stand, don’t leave me alone with the fear:
That you’ll turn away, just because you felt uneasy here.

[Bridge]
I don't want to buy you, I want no control,
I spent the whole night just worrying about your soul.
I can't simply shut down this caring in me,
Yet I don't want to shatter against your wall of safety.
Tell me if it was too much, tell me if I went too far,
So I don't stand blindly in the wreckage of where we are.

[Chorus]
I don’t want to break what we have with what I give,
I just want things to get better for you.
You know who I am—I can’t change my skin,
I built this friendship with no conditions locked in.
I’m working on seeing where your boundaries lie,
To grasp why you feel in my debt when I try.
Just tell me where I stand, don’t leave me alone with the fear:
That you’ll turn away, just because you felt uneasy here.

[Outro]
No invoice. No price.
Just the two of us.
Just tell me that it was okay.
And that I'm still by your side.

sheet.title: my_test_01
sheet.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sitting barefoot on the chilly kitchen tiles
My left sock flew to Rome to walk the miles
It’s been gone since late November anyway
Probably having tea with the Pope today
The cat stares deep into the spin-cycle drum
Like she sees ghosts where the sweaters hum
And my coffee tastes oddly sweet inside
Though it's just black despair that I try to hide

[Chorus]
Oh the world keeps spinning and I spin along
The bread falls jelly-side down where it don't belong
Strumming two easy chords on this old acoustic pine
Wondering why pigeons freeze this spine of mine
It’s a beautiful day to be out of your mind
Pull up a chair, grab the tap water you can find

[Verse]
Down at the hardware store I bought some PVC
Held it like a telescope just to see
A guy with a mustache gave a heavy sigh
'Cause sound don't travel through a pipe so dry
Still I swore I heard the ocean wave's hum
Or the big air vent where the paint fumes come
My bicycle Klaus has got a flattened tire
Leaning tired by the yard in his rusty attire

[Chorus]
Oh the world keeps spinning and I spin along
The bread falls jelly-side down where it don't belong
Strumming two easy chords on this old acoustic pine
Wondering why pigeons freeze this spine of mine
It’s a beautiful day to be out of your mind
Pull up a chair, grab the tap water you can find

[Bridge]
Maybe I'll call the hotline on the wall
Ask how to iron out the clouds this fall
Or maybe I’ll sit right here by the door
Counting ticks on the clock down on the floor
Real still
Just bending to my own sweet will

[Chorus]
Oh the world keeps spinning and I spin along
The bread falls jelly-side down where it don't belong
Strumming two easy chords on this old acoustic pine
Wondering why pigeons freeze this spine of mine
It’s a beautiful day to be out of your mind
Pull up a chair, grab the tap water you can find

[Outro]
That wandering sock will write a card before too long
Until then I'll just sit here humming my song
Hm-mm
Klaus needs some air

sheet.title: Test-001
sheet.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Leave your heavy coat right by the door
Let your tired boots drop to the floor
The kettle's humming quiet on the stove
A little island where the wild winds slow
You don’t have to tell me where you’ve been
Just pull up a chair, take a breath, let it in

[Pre-Chorus]
The world outside was screaming loud
Lost our footing in the crowd
Now the noise begins to fade away
And there is nothing that you need to explain

[Chorus]
With you, it’s easy like an open sky
No walls to climb, no reason to hide
We’ve carried the dark, we’ve weathered the gray
Now watch all that sorrow just melting away
Oh, it’s good to know we’re safe right here
Nothing to prove, and nothing to fear
Just you and me, breathing in relief

[Verse 2]
Remember that October on the porch?
Laughing till our morning throats were sore
Years roll on, the seasons change their clothes
Every step we take, this circle grows
You know my silence just as well as speech
A steady shoulder always within reach

[Pre-Chorus]
The shadows try to make a stand
Then I feel the reassurance in your hand
And the ground is solid beneath our feet
Life gets softer every time we meet

[Chorus]
With you, it’s easy like an open sky
No walls to climb, no reason to hide
We’ve carried the dark, we’ve weathered the gray
Now watch all that sorrow just melting away
Oh, it’s good to know we’re safe right here
Nothing to prove, and nothing to fear
Just you and me, breathing in relief

[Bridge]
It’s the late-night tea and the crooked smile
Walking side-by-side for another mile
Whenever the anchor starts to slip
You hold the line with a gentle grip
It’s love without the questions asked
A light that’s built to always last

[Chorus]
With you, it’s easy like an open sky
No walls to climb, no reason to hide
We’ve carried the dark, we’ve weathered the gray
Now watch all that sorrow just melting away
Oh, it’s good to know we’re safe right here
Nothing to prove, and nothing to fear
Just you and me, breathing in relief

[Outro]
Yeah, just breathe...
Let it all drop to the floor.
Safe right here.
Home at the door.

Der Zeiger schlägt im leeren Raum
Ein Schatten wandert stumm am Zaun
